sources.title: qwen-plus Model Info (updated October 11, 2026)
sources.evidence: Reopened for the October 27 parameter re-audit. The October 11 page still states that qwen-plus is functionally equivalent to qwen-plus-2025-12-01. It describes text I/O, thinking and a 1M-token context but gives neither total nor active parameters and identifies no named sized base model.

sources.title: Qwen Key Concepts (v2.5 documentation)
sources.evidence: Reopened for the parameter re-audit. The Qwen team identifies Qwen Plus as a proprietary language model, separately from open-weight releases. This establishes product identity, not a parameter count or lineage to a particular open model.

sources.title: Models.dev qwen-plus record
sources.evidence: Contains the baseline January 25, 2024 release date, but supplies no primary launch citation. Used only to trace that claim.

sources.title: Text generation models (updated October 15, 2026)
sources.evidence: Lists qwen-plus and its snapshots under Legacy Qwen, with 1M context, thinking and function calling support; distinct from qwen3.7-plus.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates (updated October 27, 2026)
sources.evidence: The December 1, 2025 Qwen Plus release entry describes better reasoning, agents, multi-turn tools and creative tasks relative to the July 28 snapshot. July 28 is described as a Qwen3-series Plus model. Neither entry identifies a sized base or reports total/active parameters. The September 11 Qwen Plus snapshot and Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B releases are separate entries; their shared date and similar capability descriptions do not establish model identity.

sources.title: Qwen3: Think Deeper, Act Faster
sources.evidence: Publishes nominal counts of 235B total/22B active and 30B total/3B active for the named open-weight MoE models, alongside six dense models. It does not identify Qwen Plus or its December snapshot as a variant or post-trained version of any named sized release. These specifications cannot be transferred on family membership alone.

sources.title: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: The developer specifies 80B total and 3B activated parameters, hybrid Gated DeltaNet/attention and high-sparsity MoE for this named model. It gives no Qwen Plus lineage. This is a materially distinct architecture from the original Qwen3 releases; long-context support and neighboring release dates cannot establish that qwen-plus-2025-12-01 shares its size or architecture.

sources.title: Original Qwen DashScope documentation listing qwen-plus (October 16, 2023)
sources.evidence: The October 16, 2023 immutable README names qwen-turbo and qwen-plus as available DashScope hosted APIs, distinguishes their speed/quality and provides API-key onboarding plus SDK installation instructions. It establishes that qwen-plus existed by October 16, 2023 without claiming an original release date.

sources.title: Qwen original API documentation commit metadata
sources.evidence: The official repository commit is timestamped October 16, 2023. Inspection of earlier October 14 README and this revision locates the documentation addition; a documentation commit timestamp alone does not establish the model launch date.

name.note: Official product name; hyphenation is stylistic.

release_date.note: The original Qwen README revision dated October 16, 2023 explicitly offers qwen-plus through DashScope and supplies API onboarding instructions. This establishes availability by that day, materially earlier than the prior catalog date, but the documentation addition does not say the model was launched that day. No primary source establishing its initial launch date was located; later dated alias targets remain distinct.

open_weights.note: Explicitly proprietary; hosted alias has no identified public weight release.

license.note: Licensing category, not an identified open-weight license or a substitute for API service terms.

parameters_b.note: Fresh primary-source review and English/Chinese disclosure searches found no nominal total count or explicit named sized-base lineage for the current qwen-plus-2025-12-01 target. The release history establishes Qwen3-series membership and capability updates, not identity with Qwen3-235B-A22B or Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B. No supported nominal size is being withheld for lack of a tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked independently from total parameters. The alias and December snapshot documentation give no activated count or expert configuration. The published 22B/3B active figures belong to distinct named open models, with no established lineage to this target; neither a total-to-active equality nor either MoE count is inferred.

architecture.note: No exact hosted-version architecture disclosed. Dense/MoE and open-model configurations cannot be inherited.

context_window.note: Documented context capacity in tokens, distinct from maximum input length.

reasoning.note: Legacy qwen-plus explicitly supports thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Supported capability, with deployment caveat: detail page marks Beijing supported and listed non-Beijing regions unsupported; overview is unqualified.

description.value: Proprietary Qwen text model for multilingual chat and thinking, with function calling availability varying by deployment region.
description.note: Adds proprietary status and avoids implying universal endpoint tool availability.

patch.description: Proprietary Qwen text model for multilingual chat and thinking, with function calling availability varying by deployment region.
patch.notes: The qwen-plus alias maps to qwen-plus-2025-12-01. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed: no nominal size or named sized-base lineage was found. Architecture and original alias launch date remain unresolved. Function calling availability varies by deployment region. Fresh repository-history research establishes qwen-plus API availability by October 16, 2023, but no original launch date is verified.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit reconfirmed the December 1, 2025 alias target and checked its release history against primary Qwen3 and Qwen3-Next specifications. No developer nominal total/active count or explicit named sized-base lineage was found for that target. Both counts remain undisclosed with explicit null patches; distinct open-model sizes and architectures are not inherited from family membership or matching release dates. Other audited fields are preserved. The release-date re-audit checked original 2023 repository history and developer searches: qwen-plus was documented as an available API by October 16, 2023, but no dated launch announcement was found. The release date remains null instead of substituting a documentation edit or a later snapshot date.

searches: QwenLM/Qwen README_CN commit history from August through November 2023

accessed_originals.evidence: The October 16, 2023 immutable README names qwen-turbo and qwen-plus as available DashScope hosted APIs, distinguishes their speed/quality and provides API-key onboarding plus SDK installation instructions. It establishes that qwen-plus existed by October 16, 2023 without claiming an original release date.

The official repository commit is timestamped October 16, 2023. Inspection of earlier October 14 README and this revision locates the documentation addition; a documentation commit timestamp alone does not establish the model launch date.

findings: The original API documentation substantially predates previously checked 2024 quota notices and baseline dates.
The original text describes currently available API options, without an author-dated initial release declaration.
limitations: No primary launch day or month was verified. The by-date is an availability bound and is not placed into release_date.
